summary:
A product announcement from FMLink covering Cleo, the newest metal seating collection from Stance Healthcare, aimed at healthcare environments. The piece frames the core design problem as a gap between the durability and cleanability that healthcare facilities require and the comfort and visual warmth that patients, families, and caregivers want from furniture they use daily.

Cleo is positioned as a rethink of a familiar healthcare furniture category, moving away from the rigid, linear look usually associated with metal seating toward softer, more welcoming forms while retaining strength and performance. It comes in Guest and Lounge models, built on a sculptural powder-coated steel frame with a signature double-wrapped back intended to convey support and embrace. Flowing transitions and curved geometry are said to soften the chair's visual presence.

The collection was designed in collaboration with furniture designer Dave Simon. Practical features include minimal seams, a 360-degree clean-out design, and easy-to-maintain surfaces to support infection prevention and simplify cleaning routines. Standard wall-saver legs are included for durability and stability, and the Lounge collection uses an elastomeric suspension system for long-lasting comfort.

Specification flexibility is emphasized through a range of frame finishes, arm cap options, and upholstery selections, so designers can build cohesive healthcare interiors. The stated outcome is furniture that combines traditional metal seating durability with upholstered comfort, supporting occupant well-being without compromising performance, consistent with Stance Healthcare's "Improving Lives by Design" positioning.

The article closes with an event call to action: the Cleo Guest and Lounge Collection is on display at the Healthcare Design Conference + Expo, October 18-20, booth #1627. The post is dated October 19, 2026. No pricing, lead times, performance test data, or customer references are provided; the content reads as vendor-supplied promotional copy rather than independent review.

Cleo features minimal seams and a 360-degree clean-out design to support infection prevention and simplify cleaning
